signature.name: Basilica of Notre-Dame de Fourvière
signature.detail: Lyon's most famous sight, a hilltop basilica with sweeping views over the city and the Saône. It is a working religious site, so dress respectfully and keep quiet inside. Go early morning or late afternoon for softer light and fewer crowds; you can walk up from Vieux Lyon or take the funicular.

signature.name: Vieux Lyon
signature.detail: One of Europe's largest Renaissance old towns, a maze of cobbled lanes and hidden passageways worth wandering for an afternoon. It sits at the foot of Fourvière, so pair the two in one outing. Come on a weekday to avoid the heaviest crowds.

signature.name: Traboules of Croix-Rousse
signature.detail: These covered passageways were used by silk workers and let you cut through buildings between streets. They are a distinctive Lyon experience and best explored on a guided walk, since some are private and closed to visitors. Wear comfortable shoes for the hills.

signature.name: Parc de la Tête d'Or
signature.detail: A large central park with a lake, gardens and a free botanical and zoo area, ideal for a relaxed break. It is free to enter and easy to reach by metro or bus. Visit in the morning for calm and cooler weather.

signature.name: Place Bellecour
signature.detail: A vast open square in the heart of the city, a natural meeting point between the two rivers and the old town. It is free and open at all hours. Use it as a landmark to orient yourself before heading to Vieux Lyon or the shops.

signature.name: Cathédrale Saint-Jean-Baptiste
signature.detail: A Gothic cathedral in Vieux Lyon with fine stained glass and an astronomical clock. Entry to the cathedral is generally free, though dress modestly. It is a short walk from the Saône and fits easily into an old-town stroll.

signature.name: Musée des Confluences
signature.detail: A striking modern museum at the meeting of the Rhône and Saône, covering natural history and world cultures. Its architecture alone is worth the trip. Check opening days and buy tickets online to skip queues.

signature.name: Saône River Cruise
signature.detail: A boat trip on the Saône gives a different view of the old town and the hills. It is a good way to rest your feet after walking. Book a daytime departure and arrive a little early for a good seat.

transport: Metro/tram about $2 a ride; day pass around $7
